hook: 字尾 -ment：predicament 困境、emolument 報酬、retrenchment 緊縮——櫃台叫號：先領狀態再領薪水。
script: predicament 困境。emolument 薪給。retrenchment 緊縮。commencement 開始。discernment 洞察。clement／inclement 天氣旁門。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 叫號單: predicament walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「叫號單」出場：predicament 一上場梗就黏住——困境。

members.senseAnchor: compensation received by virtue of holding an office or having employment (usually in the form of wages or fees)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 薪水袋: emolument walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「薪水袋」出場：emolument 一上場梗就黏住——報酬。

members.senseAnchor: entrenchment consisting of an additional interior fortification to prolong the defense; the reduction of expenditures in order to become financially stable
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 剪刀標: retrenchment walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「剪刀標」出場：retrenchment 一上場梗就黏住——緊縮裁減。

members.senseAnchor: the cognitive condition of someone who understands; delicate discrimination (especially of aesthetic values)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 眼鏡櫃: discernment walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「眼鏡櫃」出場：discernment 一上場梗就黏住——洞察力。

related.synonyms: understanding, apprehension, savvy, taste, appreciation, perceptiveness

members.speakLineZh: 請「起跑槍」出場：commencement 一上場梗就黏住——開始。

members.senseAnchor: (of weather or climate) physically mild; (used of persons or behavior) inclined to show mercy
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 溫柔風: clement walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「溫柔風」出場：clement 一上場梗就黏住——溫和的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 雨傘架: inclement walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「雨傘架」出場：inclement 一上場梗就黏住——惡劣的。

members.speakLineZh: 請「想像泡」出場：figment 一上場梗就黏住——虛構。

members.senseAnchor: the act of getting possession of something

members.speakLineZh: 請「採購單」出場：procurement 一上場梗就黏住——採購取得。

members.senseAnchor: establishment of or state of having cordial relations

members.speakLineZh: 請「握手台」出場：rapprochement 一上場梗就黏住——和解修好。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English

members.senseAnchor: semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation; toiletry consisting of any of various substances in the form of a thick liquid that have a soothing and moisturizing effect when applied to the skin
